claims.assertion: The Pleiades has 11 main civilizations, not one uniform race.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Taygetans occupy four planets and belong to the Federation through Alcyone.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Alfratans descend from Earth humans and dominate Federation activity near Earth.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Andromedans live aboard biosphere ships; Viera is Federation’s local headquarters.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Urmah are feline Federation members who may reject Federation policies.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Greys include 165 types; Zeta Gardeners differ from invasive Orion variants.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Reptilians vary widely; Kingu live underground, but not all are hostile.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Maitre are engineered hybrids whose low-frequency limits restrict where they live.
claims.speaker: Gosia
